description: This file implements the core algorithms for merging diffs, including handling conflicts, line comparisons, and merge refinements in a source code management or diff/merge library.

classes.name: xdmerge_t

methods.name: int recmatch(xrecord_t * rec1,xrecord_t * rec2,unsigned long flags)

methods.description: Further refines conflicts by diffing the conflict regions to find minimal differing sets.

methods.name: void xdl_merge_two_conflicts(xdmerge_t * m)

methods.description: Simplifies merge by collapsing non-conflicting hunks if they are very close.
